name: Akizuki-ke no Jusei Irai -Ninshin Suru made Kurikaesareru, Tsuma to Ani to no Sex-
original_name: 秋月家の受精依頼 ―妊娠するまで繰り返される、妻と兄とのセックス―
source:
"He was only supposed to be a surrogate."

The tests proved it: a would-be father couldn't bear children.

It was a bitter realization, but that was nothing compared to
watching his beloved wife f*ck his brother every day and fall in love.
